title: Other cities he travelled to
summary: Howard says he never went to New York, Cincinnati or Texas in those days and California only in later years.

story.theme_name: Life on the road: touring bands, buses and one-nighters
story.community_name: Life on the road: buses, trains and one-nighters

blocks.x: Any other cities that you got to, like New York or Cincinnati in those days? Those old days?
No, no, no, I never go.
Never go to California except in late years?
What about any other, aside from Mobile, Mississippi, did you ever get up to Shreveport or? No, I never go to Texas. No, I never go to Texas.

All the time I went to Texas when I was George, then I went to Fort Worth and passed through Texas, you know, but mostly out of Mississippi and Alabama, see, or New Ibarium, some of them places like that, you know.
Yeah, no time is very close to you.
No, I never go to the west too much.
